result.subject: Request for a 30-Minute Lab Tour During Student Expedition
result.body:
Your recent work on autonomous vehicle perception at Tongji University has significantly advanced the field. We are a small group of engineering students visiting Shanghai to explore cutting-edge research in intelligent transportation systems. We write to seek your guidance on how your expertise informs current challenges in the field.

Our group is particularly interested in your research on sensor fusion, as it directly relates to our project on improving real-time data processing in urban environments. We hope to gain insights into your methodologies and practical applications to enhance our understanding of the subject.

We would be honored to request a 30-minute lab tour during our visit, at a time that is convenient for you. We are happy to adapt our schedule to accommodate your availability. Thank you for considering our request.
